uiLanguage.name: Module language
uiLanguage.hint: Language of Swift Dice on this device. Follow Foundry uses Foundry's language.

enabled.name: Show dice on this device
enabled.hint: Turn it off to see only the chat cards. Their results then show at once.

placement.name: Where the dice fall
placement.hint: On this device: beside the chat, where they cover no tokens, or in the middle of the screen.

size.name: Size of the dice
size.hint: Size of one die in pixels on this device.

linger.name: Dice stay for
linger.hint: Seconds the dice stay on the table after they landed, on this device.

deviceEffects.name: Light and particles on this device
deviceEffects.hint: Glowing dice, trails and the moments of triumphs and fumbles. Turn it off on a slow computer.

sounds.name: Sounds of the dice
sounds.hint: On this device: the dice click when they hit the table, in the sound of their material, and some ways of throwing have their own sounds. Uses Foundry's interface volume.

sceneControl.name: Button in the token controls
sceneControl.hint: Shows the button for My dice in the token controls on the left.

reveal.name: Results in the chat
reveal.hint: When the dice have landed: the card appears at once, its result shows the moment the dice lie still. It never waits longer than the throw. At once: no wait.

speed.name: Speed of a throw
speed.hint: The same for everyone, so all see the dice land together.

colors.name: Dice colors
colors.hint: Every user's dice take the color they picked in Foundry. With the first choice players may pick their own colors in My dice. Surface, pattern and font are always theirs to pick.

initiative.name: Throw initiative rolls
initiative.hint: Also throw dice for initiative from the combat tracker.

npcRolls.name: Throw rolls of characters no player owns
npcRolls.hint: Also throw dice for monsters and other characters of the GM.

hiddenRolls.name: Hidden rolls
hiddenRolls.hint: Rolls whose result someone may not see, such as blind rolls and rolls whispered to the GM.
hiddenRolls.own: Covered dice for the one who rolled
hiddenRolls.all: Covered dice for everyone who sees the card

moments.name: Big moments
moments.hint: Which results count as a triumph or a fumble. They glow, and the moment each player picked in My dice plays. The game system decides, or a rule of your own in the three fields below.
moments.system: As the game system counts them

momentDie.name: Own rule: die
momentDie.hint: The die that decides. Every die: all dice with numbers.

momentTriumph.name: Own rule: triumph on
momentTriumph.hint: Results of that die that are a triumph, like 20, 19-20 or 1, 2. max is the highest number of the die. Empty: none. Starts with the rule of the game system.

momentFumble.name: Own rule: fumble on
momentFumble.hint: Results of that die that are a fumble, written the same way. Empty: none.

effects.name: Light and particles
effects.hint: What the dice may show at this table. Each device can turn them off for itself.
effects.crits: Only the moments of triumphs and fumbles

maxDice.name: Dice per throw
maxDice.hint: Larger throws show this many dice and a counter for the rest.

minFps.name: Skip dice on slow screens
minFps.hint: Below this many frames per second, measured over the last seconds on each screen, that screen skips the dice and shows the result at once. 0 always shows them.

MyDice.title: My dice
MyDice.menuHint: Pick how your dice look for everyone at the table, and throw test dice.
MyDice.everyone: Everyone at the table sees your dice like this.
MyDice.locked: Your GM uses the player color for everyone.
MyDice.d20: My d20 in its own color
MyDice.effectsOff: Light and particles are off at this table or on this device, the others still see yours.
MyDice.coreHint: Shows through glass and crystal. Picking it turns other materials into glass.
MyDice.byClass: My dice follow the class of the character who rolls
MyDice.byClassNone: No character selected or assigned. Rolls without a class keep your own look.
MyDice.byClassUnknown: {name}: no class found, your own look is used.
MyDice.resetHint: Back to dice in your player color without effects.
MyDice.colorAuto: automatic, follows the die or its light. Pick a color to change it.

Rules.d20: a natural 20 on a d20 is a triumph, a natural 1 a fumble.
Rules.dnd5e: critical hits and fumbles of d20 rolls as D&D 5e reports them, also a wider critical range like 19 to 20. Damage rolls have none.
Rules.pf2e: critical successes and critical failures of checks against a DC, also without a natural 20. Without a DC a natural 20 or 1 counts.
Rules.swade: a critical failure (snake eyes) and a raise on a trait roll.
Rules.crucible: a check that beats the DC by more than 6, or misses it by 6 or more.
Rules.duality: hope and fear dice showing the same number, a critical success.
Rules.under100: roll under, 01 on the d100 is a triumph and 100 a fumble.
Rules.under20: roll under, a 1 on the d20 is a triumph and a 20 a fumble.
Rules.d10: a 10 on the d10 is a critical success, a 1 a critical failure.
Rules.sixes: two or more sixes are a critical.
Rules.successes: every six is a success and glows.
Rules.fate: four plus signs are a triumph, four minus signs a fumble.
Rules.boxcars: a double six is a triumph, a double one a fumble.
Rules.cypher: a 19 or 20 is a triumph, a 1 a fumble.
Rules.gurps: 3 or 4 on three dice is a critical success, 17 or 18 a critical failure.
Rules.power: a natural 19 or 20 on a power roll is a critical.
Rules.glitch: a glitch, more than half of the dice show a 1.
Rules.none: its dice show symbols, there are no big moments.

Notice.diceSoNice: Swift Dice stays off while Dice So Nice is active, so nobody sees two sets of dice. Turn off one of the two modules.

DEBUG.Title: Debug file
DEBUG.Hint: Saves one file for bug reports about all of Sephral’s modules in this world: versions, settings and what the modules recorded, such as the latest chat messages they read. It contains chat text and whispers, check it before you share it.
DEBUG.Saved: Debug file {file} saved. It contains chat text and whispers, check it before you share it.
